d:
This story was born from an obsession: erotica seen through the eyes of a woman discovering her own depravity. I'm not interested in soft romance. I'm fascinated by raw, intense, exhausting sex—the kind that forces a woman to cross lines she never imagined crossing. The kind of sex that makes her feel used, humiliated, transformed into a whore... and ultimately makes her discover she loves every second of it.

Kyouka is the perfect vessel for this journey. Through her, we explore how a woman can move from restraint to total surrender, how she can discover that being a "slut" in bed with the right man isn't degradation—it's liberation. She begins as a controlled professional executive and ends as a creature of pure desire, begging for more, accepting her most basic nature and enjoying it without shame.

This is my first manga-format story created with AI. Just a few years ago, this was an impossible dream. Now, thanks to technology, I can materialize these fantasies that previously existed only in my mind. Every page, every dialogue, every moan from Kyouka represents hours of learning, trial and error, and pure passion for this art.

What's coming next:

The next story will be about a lifeguard at a beach house—shorter, more focused, with the lessons learned from this first experiment. And for Kyouka... her story doesn't end here. In the future, we'll see her explore new territories: anal, BDSM, limits she hasn't yet crossed. Because once a woman discovers the pleasure of total surrender, she always wants more.

If you enjoyed this journey with Kyouka and want to see more of my work, visit my Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/AnimaVirtus

Thank you for joining me in this dream made reality.
